meta_data.base_class: Analyze and provide dietary and nutritional advice for <pet animals> - refers to various common pet species. Note: when generalizing this tool, avoid enumerating species (e.g., specific dog breeds or bird types) and instead describe them as open string types.

tool_template.name: petNutritionAnalyzer_analyze<class>Diet
tool_template.description: Analyzes and provides dietary recommendations for common pet <class> based on their species and age.

age.description: The age of the <class> in years. Minimum value is 0.

healthConditions.description: List of any known health conditions the <class> has.

timeOfDay.description: Preferred time of day for feeding analysis to consider.

activityLevel.description: The activity level of the <class>, which may influence dietary needs (e.g., low, moderate, high).

dietaryRestrictions.description: List of any known dietary restrictions or allergies the <class> has.

environment.description: The type of environment where the <class> resides, which might affect its diet (e.g., indoor, outdoor, mixed).

weight.description: The weight of the <class> in kilograms, which can impact dietary analysis.

feedingFrequency.description: The number of times the <class> is fed per day.
